movie.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
movie.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

alternativeTitles.title: ゴジラ-0.0（ゴジラマイナスゼロ）

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Two years after recovering from the war and Godzilla's initial assault, Japan faces a devastating new crisis in 1949 as humanity's fragile peace is suddenly shattered.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Set in 1949, two years after the devastating events of Godzilla Minus One, Japan has slowly begun to rebuild its ruined nation and reclaim a sense of daily life. However, just as the populace manages to secure a hard-won peace, an unprecedented disaster strikes without warning. The Shikishima family and the survivors of the previous attack must unite once more to confront an escalating existential crisis. Facing unimaginable destruction, humanity must fight to ensure it is not pushed past zero.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Picking up in 1949, Japan is struggling to emerge from the double tragedy of its post-WWII devastation and Godzilla's catastrophic rampage two years prior. Through sheer perseverance and community effort, the country has made painful strides toward stability, restoring basic infrastructure and reclaiming everyday life. Just as former pilot Kōichi Shikishima and his family begin to experience the comforts of a hard-earned peace, a terrifying new threat emerges. Plunging the nation back into chaos, the crisis forces both citizens and military officials to re-examine the trauma they thought they had left behind. Scientists and military strategists race against time to formulate a defense against a calamity far worse than the first monster attack. Tensions mount as resources prove limited, leaving humanity with almost no room for error. Old allies reunite and new strategies are tested in a desperate bid to preserve the country's fragile recovery. Ultimately, the survivors must risk everything in a high-stakes struggle to ensure their country is not totally extinguished.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Taking place in 1949, two years after Japan was reduced to ruin by war and subsequently ravaged by Godzilla, the nation has endured an agonizing struggle to rebuild. Society has slowly stabilized, allowing survivors to reclaim a semblance of peace and hope for the future. However, this delicate tranquility is abruptly shattered when a deadly new calamity strikes. As terror sweeps across the nation once more, the survivors—including the Shikishima family—must face an escalating threat that endangers everything they fought to rebuild, testing the limits of human resilience in the ultimate fight for survival.

story_structure.climax: Humanity engages in a desperate, high-stakes final confrontation against the overwhelming threat, risking everything to prevent total destruction.
story_structure.conflict: Just as a fragile peace is established, a terrifying new threat emerges, crushing the nation's hard-won recovery and plunging humanity into renewed crisis.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the intense clash, the survivors confront the long road ahead, striving to endure and rebuild their lives once again.
story_structure.introduction: Following the devastation of war and initial monster attacks, Japan enters a period of rebuilding as citizens attempt to reclaim peace and normalcy.
story_structure.risingAction: As panic spreads, survivors and defense authorities scramble to devise a strategy and mount a coordinated defense before all progress is destroyed.

characters.name: Koichi Shikishima

characters.name: Noriko Ooto
characters.description: A compassionate survivor who builds an impromptu home with Shikishima and serves as his emotional grounding.

characters.name: Kenji Noda
characters.description: A former naval scientist and strategist who formulates the plan to neutralize Godzilla.

characters.name: Yoji Akitsu
characters.description: The pragmatic captain of the mine-sweeping vessel who leads and supports his crew through the crisis.

characters.name: Shiro Mizushima
characters.description: An eager young boat crew member whose youthful enthusiasm brings levity to dangerous situations.

characters.name: Sosaku Tachibana
characters.description: A skilled airplane mechanic whose past history with Shikishima helps bring the hero's arc full circle.

characters.name: Sumiko Ota
characters.description: A stern yet caring neighbor who helps raise Akiko and offers vital support to Shikishima.

characters.name: Godzilla
characters.description: An unstoppable, mutated giant kaiju that unleashes catastrophic destruction upon a recovering nation.

faq.answer: Yes, Godzilla Minus Zero is part of Toho's long-running Godzilla franchise. It serves as a direct sequel to the 2023 film Godzilla Minus One and is the 39th entry in the overall Godzilla film series.
faq.question: Is Godzilla Minus Zero part of a franchise?

faq.answer: Yes, it is a direct continuation. The story picks up in 1949, two years after the events of Godzilla Minus One, following the surviving members of the Shikishima family as a new calamity emerges.
faq.question: Is Godzilla Minus Zero a direct sequel to Godzilla Minus One?

faq.answer: The film primarily belongs to the sci-fi kaiju, action, and historical period drama genres, combining giant monster spectacle with human drama set in post-WWII Japan.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of Godzilla Minus Zero?

faq.answer: The film is written, directed, and has visual effects supervised by Takashi Yamazaki, who also directed Godzilla Minus One.
faq.question: Who is the director of Godzilla Minus Zero?

faq.answer: The movie is scheduled to open theatrically in Japan on November 3, 2026, followed by a theatrical release in North America and international territories on November 6, 2026.
faq.question: When is Godzilla Minus Zero released in theaters?

faq.answer: As with many Toho Godzilla releases, fans should stay through the credits for any potential teasers or stingers, though specific post-credits details remain under wraps prior to full theatrical release.
faq.question: Is there a post-credit scene in Godzilla Minus Zero?

faq.answer: Main cast members from Godzilla Minus One return to reprise their roles, including Ryunosuke Kamiki as Kōichi Shikishima and Minami Hamabe as Noriko Shikishima, alongside returning supporting cast members Hidetaka Yoshioka, Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, and Sakura Ando.
faq.question: Which cast members return for Godzilla Minus Zero?

faq.answer: Yes, Godzilla Minus Zero holds the distinction of being the first Japanese feature film shot with high-definition digital cameras certified for Filmed for IMAX.
faq.question: Was Godzilla Minus Zero shot specifically for IMAX?

faq.answer: The movie was produced in Japan and filmed primarily in the Japanese language, with official localized dubs and subtitles provided for international releases.
faq.question: What language was Godzilla Minus Zero originally produced in?
